cards.text: Jesus has just fed a crowd of about five thousand men, besides women and children (Matthew 14:21). Right away, He makes the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to the other side, while He sends the crowds away.

cards.question: Once the crowds are gone, Jesus goes up on the mountain by Himself to pray.

cards.text: Evening comes, and Jesus is up on the mountain alone. Meanwhile the boat is far from land, and the waves are slapping it around the way I slap dough on the counter: HARD, and over and over.

cards.question: The disciples' boat is getting beaten by the waves because the ___ is against it.

cards.text: Then, during the fourth watch of the night, Jesus goes out to them. The FOURTH WATCH, friend. That's so late your alarm clock hasn't even started thinking about you yet.

cards.question: During the fourth watch of the night, how does Jesus get out to the disciples' boat?

cards.text: The disciples see Him walking on the sea, and they are TERRIFIED. Honestly, I'd scream too, and I scream when an oven timer goes off that I forgot I set.

cards.question: The terrified disciples cry out in fear. They think Jesus is a ___.
Jesus waits a while before He says anything to the terrified disciples.

cards.text: Jesus speaks up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.” Then Peter, one of Jesus' disciples, calls back, “Lord, if it is You,” and asks Him for something.

cards.question: With Jesus out there on the water, what does Peter ask Him to do?

answers.text: Command him to come on the water

cards.text: Jesus answers with one word: “Come.” Then Peter gets down out of the boat, while I need a running start and a pep talk just to hop into a bowl of chocolate chips.

cards.question: After Peter gets down out of the boat, he walks on the water and comes toward Jesus.

cards.text: Then Peter does what I do every single time I'm finally getting something right. He looks around.

cards.question: Out on the water, Peter sees something, gets afraid and begins to sink. What does he see?

cards.text: Peter starts to sink and cries out, “Lord, save me!” Three words. Nobody going under ever opened with small talk.

cards.question: As Peter sinks, Jesus ___ reaches out His hand and takes hold of him.

cards.text: Jesus tells him, “You of little faith,” and asks, “why did you doubt?” I bet Peter's just hanging there DRIPPING, searching for any answer besides, well, the wind.

cards.question: Jesus and Peter are still out on the sea. When does the wind finally die down?

answers.text: When they climb back into the boat
When Peter cries out for help
When Jesus speaks to the wind

cards.question: The wind dies down, and everyone in the boat ___ Jesus, saying He is truly the ___ of God.

cards.text: They cross over and land at Gennesaret, and the men there recognize Jesus. Friend, nobody ever recognizes me, and I've got a mustache you can see from space.

cards.question: Once the men of Gennesaret recognize Jesus, they keep His visit to themselves.

cards.text: And HERE THEY COME. People bring all the sick to Him, like the whole region just heard somebody yell “FREE COOKIES.”

cards.question: In Gennesaret, what do the people beg Jesus to let them do?

answers.text: Just touch the fringe of His cloak
Hear Him teach beside the sea

cards.question: In Gennesaret, all who touch Jesus are healed.
